title: 第735章双子星蛊师之威第734章 八九死不是人
slug: 玄幻真龙为骨我刀问天下
content_zh:
老王身旁的妖卒没一个活口，他那绷紧的神经终于在这一刻松懈了下来。
他抬起袖子擦了擦额头上豆大的汗珠，对着不远处的陆去疾咧嘴一笑：
“东家，你可算来了，再晚来一会儿，我可就撑不住了。”
陆去疾一边朝着妖族大军走去，一边向老王打趣道：“就算我不来你也死不了，万一你那些红颜知己又及时赶到呢？”
陆去疾往前一步，数以万计的妖族大军退后十步，最前方那几个妖卒双腿忍不住打摆子。
于它们而言，身前的黑发少年不是人，而是一尊执掌生死的太岁神，根本挡不住！
面对陆去疾的调侃，老王单手拄剑，谦虚一笑：“东家，你可别拿我开涮了，这里可是万妖谷，我哪有红颜知己？顶、顶多就是有几个床友罢了……”
正在妖族大军中厮杀的二戒和尚听到这话嘴角猛地一抽：“啥玩意儿？床友？还tm是几个？”
二戒恨得牙根痒痒，拳上的力道瞬间加大了几分，狠狠砸向身旁的黑甲妖卒，一边挥拳，一边怒吼：“凭什么……”
四周的黑甲妖卒一边逃命，一边在心中无辜呐喊：“这和尚脑子是不是有问题！？”
“和尚不是出家人吗？人家有床友，他羡慕嫉妒个屁啊！”
“羡慕就算了，拿我们这些小喽啰出什么气啊，这哪是出家人……”
看着大杀四方的二戒，陆去疾也是一脸茫然，心想：“二戒这是受打击了？他长什么样他自己心里没数？”
想到这，陆去疾脚尖轻点，身形一晃瞬间闪身至二戒身旁。
“二戒，你知道你差在哪吗？”
陆去疾对着二戒问道。
二戒摇摇头：“不知道。”
陆去疾指着老王，笑了笑：“老王那张脸好好打扮一下，最少价值钱一千枚香火钱。”
二戒抬手摸了摸自己的下颌，冷不禁插上一嘴：“那我呢？”
陆去疾的视线转移到二戒身上，撇了撇嘴，先是故意拖长了话音：“你啊……”

而后一脸坏笑道：“还得倒贴我几枚香火钱。”
二戒对着陆去疾翻了个顶到天的白眼，没好气的怒吼道：“陆去疾，你懂个屁，脸重要个屁，佛爷是修内涵的，内涵你懂吗？”
“不动。”陆去疾摇摇头：“反正你长得没我好看。”
二戒沉默了下，旋即抬起了头，对着陆去疾破口大骂：“滚滚滚，你这张嘴真tm毒，比毒舌还毒。”
话音落下。
二戒双腿一蹬，身形疾驰而出孤身深入妖族大军。
他那两只沙包大的拳头如疾风骤雨般落下，疯狂收割着妖卒的生命。
比起陆去疾的毒舌，他更愿意面对这些凶神恶煞的妖卒。
见二戒孤军深入，陆去疾没有犹豫，立马选择跟上。
只是陆去疾的杀力实在太过恐怖，随意一拳便是二戒的极限，愣是从二戒身后赶超到了前方，将二戒远远甩在了后面。
二戒也不气馁，而是调转方向朝着妖族大军的中军大帐杀去。
两人一左一右，愣是将黑潮般的妖族大军杀出了一条长达千米的真空带。
见此情形，城头之上的黄朝笙咽下一枚丹药后高呼一声：“痛快啊！这才是我想要的江湖！”
content_en:
None of the demon soldiers beside Lao Wang survived, and his tense nerves finally relaxed at this moment.
He raised his sleeves to wipe the big beads of sweat on his forehead, and grinned at Lu Quji who was not far away:
"My boss, you're finally here. If you come a little later, I won't be able to hold on any longer."
As Lu Quji walked towards the monster army, he joked to Lao Wang: "Even if I don't come, you won't die. What if your confidants arrive in time?"
Lu Quji took a step forward, and the demon army of tens of thousands retreated ten steps. The legs of the demon soldiers at the front couldn't help but swing.
To them, the black-haired boy in front of them is not a human being, but a Tai Sui god who controls life and death. They cannot stop him at all!
Facing Lu Quji's teasing, Lao Wang held his sword with one hand and smiled modestly: "Master, please don't make fun of me. This is the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons. How can I have a confidante? At most, I only have a few bedmates..."
Monk Erjie, who was fighting in the monster army, suddenly twitched his mouth when he heard this: "What are you? Bedmates? How many of them are there?"
Erjie's teeth were itching with hatred, and the force of his fist instantly increased a bit, and he hit the black-armored demon soldier beside him fiercely. While shaking his fist, he roared: "Why..."
The black-armored demon soldiers around were running for their lives while shouting innocently in their hearts: "Is there something wrong with this monk's mind!?"
"Isn't a monk a monk? He has a bedmate, and he is so jealous!"
"Forget about envy, why are you so angry at us little minions? How can we be a monk..."
Seeing Er Jie killing everyone, Lu Quji also looked confused, thinking: "Is Er Jie being hit? He doesn't know what he looks like?"
Thinking of this, Lu Quji tapped his toes and swayed to Erjie's side.
"Er Jie, do you know where you are missing?"
Lu Quji asked Erjie.
Erjie shook his head: "I don't know."
Lu Quji pointed at Lao Wang and smiled: "Low Wang's face should be dressed up properly. It's worth at least a thousand incense coins."
Erjie raised his hand and touched his chin, and couldn't help but interjected: "What about me?"
Lu Quji's eyes shifted to Er Jie, curled his lips, and first deliberately prolonged his words: "You..."
Then he said with a bad smile: "You still have to give me a few incense coins."
Erjie rolled his eyes at Lu Quji and shouted angrily: "Lu Quji, you know nothing, your face is more important than anything else. Buddha cultivates connotation, do you understand connotation?"
"Don't move." Lu Quji shook his head: "Anyway, you are not as good-looking as me."
Erjie was silent for a moment, then raised his head and cursed loudly at Lu Qu: "Gungungun, your mouth is so venomous, even more venomous than your tongue."
The words fell.
Erjie kicked off his legs and galloped out into the monster army alone.
His two fists the size of sandbags fell like a gust of wind, wildly harvesting the lives of the demon soldiers.
He was more willing to face these vicious demon soldiers than Lu Quji's vicious tongue.
Seeing Erjie's army advancing alone, Lu Quji did not hesitate and immediately chose to follow.
It's just that Lu Quji's killing power was too terrifying. A casual punch was the limit of Er Jie. He suddenly overtook Er Jie from behind, leaving Er Jie far behind.
Erjie was not discouraged, but turned around and headed towards the central tent of the demon army to kill.
The two of them moved to the left and right, and stunned the black tide-like army of monsters into a thousand-meter-long vacuum belt.
Seeing this, Huang Chaosheng, who was on top of the city, swallowed a pill and shouted: "How happy! This is the world I want!"
